text: The Kenya GiveDirectly trial ran from 2018 to 2020. Recipients received $22 per month. Household poverty fell by 12.3% among recipients. Labour force participation was unchanged.

I support UBI. The Kenya GiveDirectly trial, which ran 2018-2020, paid recipients $22 a month, and that is a meaningful transfer at that income level.
Household poverty fell by 12.3% among recipients. Labour force participation was unchanged.
Poverty among recipients dropped 12.3%, and there was no change in labour force participation, so the usual work-disincentive objection does not hold here.
